positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
I  work closely with Program Managers and Designers developing and prototyping first party applications/experiences for HoloLens.

During my time at Microsoft I have also helped ship and develop features for the Windows 8.1 Mail application, Microsoft Edge, Cortana, and various other first party apps. I have also worked on infrastructure and tooling for collection of performance and code coverage metrics as well as functional verification through model based testing.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: I attained my Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science, with Distinction.  My Senior Thesis project involved developing a volunteer web portal for the Virginia Discovery Museum, a Charlottesville based non-profit.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed novel visualization framework, including development of a servlet in an existing software to feed this framework.

positions.description: Conducted Experimentation with relative independence on the effects of Fuel System Icing Inhibitor on the Near Infrared Spectrum of jet fuel.
